name: 28711 · Black Mtn, NC
findings: ZIP 28711 (Black Mtn) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28711 (Black Mtn) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28711 (Black Mtn) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
